text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with 
Nakayama Festa, I spotted Satono Diamond 
heading down a back alley.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Satono.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, Nakayama-san! Hello.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Did you take a wrong turn or something? 
This isn't a place for a fine young lady.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It is a place far removed from my 
usual world. That is precisely why... I 
have come here!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing an unseen world, learning, and 
deepening my knowledge. That, too, is 
something I can do for the growth of the 
Satono Group."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Hooh. So it's not just morbid 
curiosity, then."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Hey, Satono, we're just about to 
head out to our usual place for some food, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'd be delighted to join you!

And so, guided by Nakayama Festa, we made 
our way through the back alleys.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...One drink minimum? Open mic welcome? I 
wonder what kind of shop this sign is for.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's a pool hall. ...Though it's a bit 
different from your usual one.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Delinquents hanging around— ...? Huh? Hey, 
Satono? Where'd she go?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... So this is a game room! I wonder 
what brand that billiard table is...?

text_block_list.name: Rough Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Ah, dammit! The hell are you 
staring at?! You distracted me and made me 
mess up!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh? Me?

text_block_list.name: Rough Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Getting in the way of my 
shot!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry. Was I really getting 
in the way that much?

text_block_list.name: Rough Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah I'm pissed! You think a simple 
apology cuts it?! Show some real 
sincerity, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Hah, sincerity? Don't make me laugh, you 
mannerless punk.

text_block_list.name: Rough Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What's your deal, you punk...! Back the 
hell off!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The weaker they are, the louder they bark. 
...Is that really all you've got?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: N-Nakayama-san...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Quiet down. You ain't someone our lady 
should be wasting her breath on.

text_block_list.name: Rough Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kh, you bastard! I'll crush you!!

Without thinking, I stepped between the 
stranger and Nakayama Festa. To be honest, 
my legs were trembling. —But protecting my 
student is my duty!

text_block_list.name: Rough Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Shut up! Humans got no business butting 
in! If you don't get it, I'll beat it into 
ya, huh?!
choice_data_list:
(This is bad... but I can't back down 
now—!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like you want to make a big deal 
out of this. Fine by me... Bring it on.

text_block_list.name: Rough Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Gh!? Wh... What's with you...? 
S-Suddenly getting all intimidating...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"A half-baked match won't settle this. 
We've already passed the point of no 
return—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You're ready, aren't you? Ready to 
"interact"...!

text_block_list.name: Rough Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Guh... Ugh...... Dammit!

Overwhelmed by Nakayama Festa's presence, 
the delinquent Umamusume slipped away out 
of the shop...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for the trouble! Thank you so 
much for helping me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, it was a good learning experience. 
Next time, I'll do thorough research and 
try again!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I thought you'd learned your 
lesson... but looks like your resolve 
hasn't wavered one bit.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
However, don't overdo it. ...That goes for 
you too, Trainer.
choice_data_list: I don't want you to overdo it either.

I don't want you to push yourself too hard 
either

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
However, don't overdo it. ...That goes for 
you too, Trainer.
choice_data_list: I don't want you to overdo it either.

I don't want you to push yourself too hard 
either

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? I didn't. I'm used to dealing with 
types like that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief, you really are something...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Worry about your own damn self instead of 
other people.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, do you even realize how much 
danger you were in?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief, being a Trainer really is 
tough.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, do whatever you want. Just don't 
expect me to pick up your pieces.
